title: Weak Schur number WS(9), lower bound
statement: Colour 1, 2, ..., n with 9 colours so that no colour holds a solution of x + y = z with x != y, with n as large as possible; it shows WS(9) >= n. The best known lower bound is WS(9) >= 22536, by Ageron, Casteras, Pellerin, Portella, Rimmel and Tomasik (2021); a colouring of 1..22537 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the colours of 1..n in order, digits 0..8 (whitespace ignored).
score: n, the length of the colouring; it proves WS(9) >= n (larger is better)
